name: Ore to Nakayoshi Shimai no Inma na Himitsu ~Imouto ni Shinu hodo Kiraware Nagara Ane to Sex Suru Kimyou Doukyo Seikatsu~
original_name: 俺と仲良し姉妹の淫魔な秘密 ～妹に死ぬほど嫌われながら姉とセックスする奇妙な同居生活～
source:
Without asking for his opinion, the protagonist's father announces that he is going to remarry.
As such, "Kousuke" has to suddenly live with his two new step sisters.

Although the sisters have opposite personalities, they get along very well.
Kana, the older sister, calls herself Kousuke's "onee-chan" despite being younger than him, and has a very sunny and mature disposition.
Saya, the younger sister, hates men and does nothing but glare at Kousuke when he's around.

While Kousuke is still confused about the sudden developments and change in his life, his father moves to a new house with his new wife only a month later. As a result, Kousuke has to take care of his sisters. Luckily, as the sisters get along well with each other, all Kousuke needs to do is do the housework and manage the money their parents send them.

And so, their peaceful life together begins. A few weeks later, Kousuke wakes up in the same bed as Kana...

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1139820]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
主角的父亲没有征求他的意见，就宣布他要再婚。
因此，“Kousuke”必须突然与他的两个新继姐妹住在一起。

姐妹俩虽然性格相反，但相处得很好。
姐姐佳奈，虽然年纪比浩介小，但自称是浩介的“姐姐”，性格非常阳光成熟。
妹妹沙耶讨厌男人，当光介在身边时，她只会瞪着他。

当浩介仍然对生活中突然的发展和变化感到困惑时，仅仅一个月后，他的父亲就带着他的新婚妻子搬进了新房子。因此，浩介必须照顾他的姐妹们。幸运的是，姐妹俩相处融洽，浩介所需要做的就是做家务，管理父母寄给她们的钱。

就这样，他们平静的生活开始了。几周后，浩介在与加奈同一张床上醒来……
